cause_established.mechanism: Inductor lazily sets TRITON_CACHE_DIR when unset. A resumed trainer can first warm eager FLA from another cache, retaining different in-memory kernel choices.

cause_established.intervention: Select the warm-process cache before any kernel call: the isolated KDA output then matches the warm trace exactly across three repeated calls.

runtime_fix.description: Select TRITON_CACHE_DIR during runtime setup before either eager FLA warmup or Inductor. Preserve explicit paths; otherwise use triton/ under the declared Inductor directory or Speck cache. Record cache paths in benchmark receipts.

decision: Compiled production recovery remains unqualified. Do not relax tolerances or infer a speedup from these checks.
